##### Project general facts

The Central Downtown by AQUA Properties is a distinctive mixed-use development of four residential towers of varying heights joined by a shared podium. Each tower rises above a ground floor and two parking levels, with streamlined contemporary facades in light, high-quality materials that sit comfortably within the landscape. The collection offers elegant studios and spacious one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, set above a shopping mall that brings retail, dining and daily services within easy reach of every home.

The rooftop podium is a destination of its own, with a swimming pool and jacuzzi, a jogging track, an open-air gym, basketball and paddle tennis courts, a rock climbing wall and mini golf. A Zen garden, a rainforest retreat, an organic farm and a dog park sit alongside a barbecue area, an outdoor cinema, a colour fountain, food kiosks and a children's play area. Indoors, residents enjoy a health club, a yoga room, a golf simulator, a beauty salon, a daycare centre, a business centre and a multipurpose hall.

Interiors embody timeless elegance, with a palette of sleek greys and calm, earthy tones that creates a refined and welcoming atmosphere. Marble and natural stone finishes elevate every space, while large windows and balconies frame open views of the city, including the colourful gardens nearby from selected homes. Smart home technology adds everyday comfort, and homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture and decor to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Arjan is a fast-growing residential community in Dubailand, known for its mix of mid-rise apartment buildings, boutique hotels and landscaped green spaces. Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden sit on the edge of the community and give the area a colourful, family-friendly character, while cafes, supermarkets and Mediclinic Parkview Hospital cover daily needs close to home.

Umm Suqeim Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road connect residents with the wider city. Mall of the Emirates, Palm Jumeirah and Global Village are a short drive away, while Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and Dubai Marina are within comfortable reach. Schools, nurseries, clinics and Dubai Sports City with its golf course and sports facilities are nearby, making the community practical for families.

Arjan is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular mid-market residential addresses in Dubai. A central position between the coastal districts and the Dubailand growth corridor attracts professionals and families, supporting steady tenant demand. Large-scale developments with extensive amenities and integrated retail strengthen the community's appeal, underpinning healthy rental yields and long-term value for owners and investors alike.
